top_signals.title: Iranian Hardliners Call for Tanker Convoy to Defy U.S. Blockade
top_signals.summary: With Iran's revenue from crude oil and condensate exports projected to hit zero by mid-December, hardline commentators and outlets close to the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) are increasingly advocating a direct challenge to the US naval blockade of Iranian ports and waters. Their proposal is for a declared "convoy of tankers" to sail through the blockade, accompanied by threats to target the oil infrastructure of Iran's Gulf neighbors if US forces attack Iranian vessels. Iranian forces already attempted attacks on US targets in Bahrain…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US maker of Malboro mulls bid for FTSE 100 giant Imperial Brands
top_signals.summary: The US firm that makes Malboro cigarettes is mulling a bid for FTSE 100 giant Imperial Brands in a move that could add to the exodus of London Stock Exchange heavyweights. Altria Group, whose companies also include Philip Morris USA, told markets on Thursday it is in early talks regarding a takeover of Imperial Brands [...]
